prompt_md: Your friend will arrive at a uniformly random moment between 6:00 and 7:00. It's 6:40 and they're not here yet. Chance they arrive by 6:50?
prompt_short: Arrival uniform 6:00–7:00, not here at 6:40. Chance they come by 6:50?
hint_md: Which arrival times are still possible?
explain_intuition_md: Once 6:40 passes, only the last 20 minutes remain, and they are all equally likely. 6:40 to 6:50 is half of what is left. The tempting 1 in 6 (10 of 60 minutes) forgets that the first 40 minutes are ruled out.
